results.name: authenticate/cloned-counter-regression
results.description: A signature counter that fails to advance signals a cloned authenticator and must be rejected.
results.detail: rejected as expected: harbor: signature counter did not increase (stored=99, got=1): possible cloned authenticator

results.name: authenticate/happy-path
results.description: Register then authenticate honestly; signature, origin and counter all valid.

results.name: authenticate/replayed-challenge
results.description: Reusing a stale challenge from a prior ceremony must fail the challenge check.
results.detail: rejected as expected: harbor: challenge mismatch (possible replay or wrong ceremony)

results.name: authenticate/tampered-signature
results.description: Flipping a byte of the assertion signature must fail Ed25519 verification.
results.detail: rejected as expected: harbor: assertion signature verification failed

results.name: authenticate/uv-required-satisfied
results.description: UV=required with a UV-capable authenticator sets the UV flag and passes.

results.name: authenticate/wrong-origin
results.description: An assertion whose client data reports a foreign origin must be rejected.
results.detail: rejected as expected: harbor: origin "https://evil.example", want "https://harbor.example"

results.name: authenticate/wrong-rp-binding
results.description: Authenticator data carrying a foreign RP ID hash must fail the RP ID hash check.
results.detail: rejected as expected: harbor: RP ID hash mismatch

results.name: register/happy-path-uv-preferred
results.description: Honest registration with a UV-capable authenticator and preferred policy.

results.name: register/uv-required-without-uv-support
results.description: UV=required against an authenticator that cannot verify the user must be rejected.
results.detail: rejected as expected: harbor: authenticator does not support user verification
